name: Rachit Anand Srivastava
description:
I'm a Senior R&D Engineer at Avail, where I work on  Data Availability, Interop and Privacy solutions.
My expertise spans cryptography (zk proofs, threshold cryptography, TEEs), distributed systems (consensus protocols, data availability, interoperability), and protocol engineering (smart contracts, blockchain infrastructure). I've led engineering teams, published research work and shipped production software using applied cryptography.
In my free time, I lift weights, and watch anime :)
